title: Evaluating Effectiveness of Smartphone Typing as an Indicator of User Emotion

participants_devices.data_collection_system: Android-based system (TapSense) using an instrumented QWERTY keyboard

experimental_conditions.data_collection: Data collected via an Android-based system (TapSense) using an instrumented QWERTY keyboard
experimental_conditions.data_processing: SMOTE was applied to handle class imbalance, adding 9% new records

proposed_method.name: Random Forest (RF) personalized model
proposed_method.description: A personalized Random Forest classifier was used to identify four different emotion states using smartphone typing features.

primary_performance.metric: AUCROC (Area under the Receiver Operating Characteristic curve)
primary_performance.experimental_condition: 10-fold cross-validation on the over-sampled smartphone typing dataset across 22 users
primary_performance.evaluation_setting: Typing features only using a personalized Random Forest classifier

additional_results.condition: Standard deviation of the average performance
